description: Restrict the check workflow's default token to read scope. The workflow declares no permissions at any level today, so every third-party action inherits the repository default.
expectedBehavior: The check workflow declares a top-level read-only contents permission
Every existing check job still passes — none of them writes to the repository
verificationSteps: Open a pull request and confirm all check jobs pass
Read the run log's token permission summary and confirm read scope only
